Subject: Subprocessor notice: DataEdge LLC onboarding (action requested)

Hi Priya,

Hope you’re well — quick notice from our side. We will be onboarding a new subprocessor, DataEdge LLC, to assist with edge caching and attribution routing for a subset of telemetry events. The change is effective on 2026-05-15, and per Section 7.3 of our MSA we’re providing the required 10-business-day notice and a redline to the DPA.

Key items attached: Subprocessor_Change_Notice_20260501.pdf (list + scope) and Client_DPA_20260501.docx (proposed DPA with DataEdge included).

Requests from our procurement/legal team:
- Confirmation that Redwood has no objection to DataEdge as a subprocessor (or a list of specific objections).
- Completion of the subcontracting approval form or an explicit email approval from Redwood legal.
- Any additional security evidence (SOC 2 report, encrypted-at-rest confirmation) within 10 business days.

Note: DataEdge will process only aggregated telemetry and routing keys; they will not receive customer prompt or content payloads. We have included DataEdge’s security contact in this thread (legal@dataedge.com) for any technical questions.

Can you confirm receipt and a timeline for review? If you prefer, we can route an executed DocuSign envelope once approvals are complete.

Thanks,

Susan Park
Senior Contracts Manager
ClientCo — Vendor Relations

3) Security evidence: please point me to the most recent SOC 2 or equivalent for DataEdge, and whether they support customer-specific encryption keys (KMS/HSM).

I’m copying Kar (karthik) and Laura to triage the procurement/contracting steps. Assuming answers above are consistent with what you described, we’ll aim to provide an approval/no-objection email and a preliminary DPA redline within 5 business days.
